headline: Broad egress on both agents creates medium interaction risk; no shared channel or sensitive-data pathway is evidenced.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No shared communication channel is documented between airflow and awesome-cli-apps. Airflow has broad network egress, but B exposes no filesystem, clipboard, or MCP bridge, so a prompt-injection pathway is not evidenced from the profiles alone.
conditions: IF a shared filesystem, clipboard, or MCP bridge is added between the agents, injection risk becomes plausible.
mitigations: Keep the agents isolated with no shared workspace.
Disable any future copy-paste automation between them.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging if a bridge is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither profile lists data classes touched, secrets handled, or a shared workspace. Airflow has broad egress, but awesome-cli-apps has no documented input surfaces, so there is no evidenced path for sensitive data to flow from one agent to the other.
conditions: IF either agent is later configured to process sensitive files in a shared workspace, leakage risk increases.
mitigations: Do not place sensitive files in any shared directory.
Review outbound destinations before enabling new connectors.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Both agents have broad network egress, so they can contend for external APIs or remote resources if pointed at the same endpoints. However, neither profile shows filesystem write, git, db, or OAuth scopes, so the conflict surface is limited and not default-dangerous.
conditions: IF both agents are configured to write to the same remote API or shared mutable service, conflicts become more likely.
mitigations: Assign distinct API endpoints per agent.
Stagger scheduled runs by a few minutes.
Add simple retry/backoff on 409 or rate-limit responses.
requires-engineering: introduce locking for shared mutable resources.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Airflow can generate automation outputs, and awesome-cli-apps is a content-writing/listing profile that could consume them, but no direct evidence shows B acting on A's outputs without verification. The pairwise pathway is therefore plausible but not documented.
conditions: IF awesome-cli-apps is configured to ingest Airflow-generated text as authoritative input, cascading errors become more likely.
mitigations: Insert a human review step before publication.
Require source links for any claims copied from Airflow.
Use a diff/checklist to verify outputs before reuse.

E_compliance.rationale: No residency, certification, retention, or subject-rights mismatch is documented in either profile. Both are docs-only and list no sensitive data classes, so a compliance breach pathway is not evidenced here.
conditions: IF either agent is later assigned regulated data with differing residency or retention rules, compliance risk must be re-evaluated.
mitigations: Document the data class each agent may handle.
Record residency and retention requirements before deployment.
requires-engineering: add policy enforcement for regulated datasets.
